empty.streamBody: Mail Campbooks sorts into {{stream}} lands here.
empty.noInboxBody: Connect a mailbox and its mail appears here, sorted into streams.
empty.readerBody: Choose one from the list, or use the keyboard:

error.listBody: Campbooks could not reach the server. Nothing was lost.
error.conversationBody: Campbooks could not reach the server. Nothing was lost.
error.goneBody: It was removed, or you can no longer see it.

reader.label: Conversation
reader.truncated: This message is long: Campbooks shows the first part.

actions.imagesHidden_one: {{count}} remote image hidden, so the sender cannot see when you read this.
actions.imagesHidden_other: {{count}} remote images hidden, so the sender cannot see when you read this.

scout.label: Where things stand
scout.suggestionNote: Campbooks thinks this belongs in {{stream}}. It is a suggestion: nothing moves until you say so.
scout.nothing: Nothing here seems to ask anything of you.
scout.asksAction: it asks you to do something
scout.hasDeadline: it mentions a date to meet
scout.suspicious: it looks suspicious, so check the sender before you open a link
scout.sortedTaught: Campbooks put this in {{stream}}, by a rule

signals.reply_to_mismatch: Replies would go to another domain ({{evidence}}).
signals.lookalike_domain: The sender’s domain looks like a better-known one ({{evidence}}).
signals.link_elsewhere: A link goes somewhere other than it says ({{evidence}}).
signals.phishing_phrase: It asks for what phishing mail asks for (“{{evidence}}”).
signals.pressure: It pushes you to act fast (“{{evidence}}”).
signals.automated_sender: It comes from an automated address ({{evidence}}).
signals.service_sender: A service sent it, not a person.
signals.question: It asks a question.
signals.list_mail: It was sent to a list.
signals.already_paid: It says it is already paid (“{{evidence}}”).
signals.action_asked: It asks you to do something (“{{evidence}}”).
signals.security_alert: It is a security alert about something of yours (“{{evidence}}”).
signals.conditional_ask: It asks only if something applies (“{{evidence}}”).
signals.notice: It is a notice: nothing to do.
signals.no_today: Nothing in it is for today.
signals.no_phishing_tell: Nothing in it looks like phishing.

knn.neighbours: Mail like this was sorted this way before.

taught.rule: Campbooks follows a rule taught for mail like this.

compose.noInbox: Connect a mailbox to send from it.
compose.readOnly: You can read this inbox but not send from it.

saveState.failed: Could not save. Campbooks will try again.

errors.invalid_address: One of the addresses is not valid.
errors.attachments_too_large: The attachments are too large to send (25 MB at most).
errors.draft_not_editable: This message is already on its way.
errors.not_connected: This mailbox is no longer connected. Reconnect it, then send again.
errors.needs_reauth: Campbooks needs your permission again to send from this mailbox. Reconnect it, then send again.
errors.rejected: Your mail provider refused this message. Check the addresses and try again.
errors.too_large: This message is too large for your mail provider to send.
errors.unavailable: Your mail provider could not be reached, so nothing was sent. Try again.
errors.unknown_outcome: Campbooks could not confirm that this message was sent. Check your Sent folder before sending it again.
errors.not_saved: Your last changes could not be saved, so nothing was sent. Try again.
errors.draft_changed: This draft changed somewhere else. Close it and open it again to see the latest version.

compose.tooLate: Too late to undo: it was sent.

line.question: {{name}} asked you a question
line.warning: This may be phishing. Don’t use its links.
line.checkDo: Did {{name}} ask you to do something?

how.footnote: Rules answer from what the email shows on its face. An answer acts only from the confidence its eval holds at; below that it is a suggestion.

toast.notNeeded: Not needed · {{name}}. Campbooks will learn from it
toast.safe: Marked safe · {{name}}. Campbooks will learn from it
toast.failed: Could not change {{name}}: nothing changed. Try again.
toast.changed: {{name}} changed while you looked: have another look.

question.move: Move all {{count}} like this to {{stream}}, and new ones too?
question.archive: Archive all {{count}} like this, and new ones too?
question.read: Mark all {{count}} like this read, and new ones too?
question.clear: Say all {{count}} like this never need you, and new ones too?

offer.suspicious: {{count}} that look suspicious stay where they are.
offer.foot: It becomes a rule. You can undo it, or remove it later.

run.keepWorking: You can keep working. Your mail provider catches up in the background.

done.move: Moved {{count}} to {{stream}}. New ones will go there too.
done.archive: Archived {{count}}. New ones will be archived too.
done.read: Marked {{count}} read. New ones will be too.
done.clear: Cleared {{count}}. New ones won't need you.

run.failed: Campbooks could not make that rule. Nothing changed.
run.finding: Finding all the mail like this

row.read: Campbooks marked this read · like {{count}} others {{from}}

exception.question: You changed back {{count}} this month. Keep the rule “{{rule}}”?

origin.action: You taught this when you acted on one email
origin.onboarding: From your answers when you set up

list.label: Rules
list.removeQuestion: Remove this rule? New mail is no longer changed by it.
list.putBack: Also put back the {{count}} it changed
list.paused: Paused: whoever taught it can no longer change this inbox
list.empty: No rules yet. When you move, archive or clear one email, Campbooks offers to do the same to the ones like it.
